How it works

From a fragile replay
to a living flow.

01

Observe

Start from the screen that is actually visible. iosClaw records semantic landmarks, not coordinates.

02

Compile

Lower the recording into a typed flow. Values become safe inputs and targets resolve from live state.

03

Run

Execute locally in milliseconds between steps, with one approval boundary for sensitive effects.

04

Confirm

Check the postcondition. If the app, state, or evidence changed unexpectedly, iosClaw pauses.
